title: Vault: raft snapshot backup (non-destructive) + restore deliberately refused
description: `nexus backup take vault --tag demo` pulls a raft snapshot to the build host and inspects its gzip/tar meta.json (index/term). `nexus backup restore vault <id> --yes` is deliberately refused (exit 2) because restoring the live trust root is dangerous.

observe.what: raft snapshot saved to build-host ~/.nexus/backups/vault/ (~1.7 MiB), non-destructive; gzip/tar meta.json inspect OK (index/term present)
restore is deliberately refused on the live trust root (actionable error)

whatProves: VaultAdapter.BackupTakeAsync pulls a raft snapshot to the build host and verifies its meta.json (index/term) without disrupting the cluster, while BackupRestoreAsync deliberately refuses (exit 2) to overwrite the live Vault trust root.
